_comment: Fact-check verdicts for the posts' claims, in the schema of an earlier book pipeline's claim_verdicts.json. `verdicts` is keyed by sentence id (sha1 of the sentence's normalized text, 12 hex digits, from www/src/data/claims.json built by www/scripts/claims-build.mjs): status verified | plausible | disputed | not-checkable, refs [...], note. A sentence with no entry is unchecked. `numbers` is keyed by number id (<sentence id>.<index>): status accepted (the linker flagged it, a reader checked it and it is right; the note says why) | disputed. Editing a sentence changes its id, so its verdict goes STALE and the sentence is unchecked again: a changed claim must be re-checked. A disputed verdict fails claims:status. Merge new verdicts with www/scripts/claims-merge.mjs.
